_comment: Hand-authored gameplay timeline for IMG_3775.mov, in VIDEO SECONDS.
Edit the numbers here and re-run `uv run analyze author` to rebuild the level.
Times are converted to distances using the time<->distance map measured by
the CV pipeline, so the level stays correct at any playback speed. Where the
ground sits on screen also comes from the CV run line; this file only says
surfaces: `from` is the video time the character arrives on that surface.
rail     - running along the railing, above ground level
floor    - the road/lot surface from the CV run line
sidewalk - same run line, treated as its own stretch
jump     - clear it; being airborne at `time` succeeds
platform - land ON it, then jump off
dodge    - step aside rather than jump
hidden: character is not drawn (reads as teleporting)
